description: Source code for the ReceivedBlockTracker class in Apache Spark Streaming, responsible for tracking received data blocks, allocating them to batches, and optionally persisting state via write-ahead logs for fault tolerance.

classes.name: ReceivedBlockTracker
classes.description: Tracks received data blocks, manages their allocation to batches, and handles persistence via write-ahead logs.

classes.name: AllocatedBlocks
classes.description: Represents blocks allocated to a batch, mapped by stream ID.

classes.name: BlockAdditionEvent
classes.description: Event indicating a new received block has been added.

classes.name: BatchAllocationEvent
classes.description: Event indicating allocation of blocks to a batch at a specific time.

classes.name: BatchCleanupEvent
classes.description: Event indicating cleanup of old batch data.

methods.name: addBlock
methods.description: Adds a received block and logs the event if logging is enabled.

methods.name: allocateBlocksToBatch
methods.description: Allocates all unallocated blocks to a specified batch time.

methods.name: getBlocksOfBatch
methods.description: Retrieves blocks allocated to a specific batch.

methods.name: getBlocksOfBatchAndStream
methods.description: Retrieves blocks allocated to a specific batch and stream.

methods.name: hasUnallocatedReceivedBlocks
methods.description: Checks if there are any unallocated received blocks.

methods.name: getUnallocatedBlocks
methods.description: Returns blocks that have been received but not yet allocated.

methods.name: cleanupOldBatches
methods.description: Cleans up data of old batches based on a threshold time.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the tracker and closes resources.

methods.name: recoverPastEvents
methods.description: Recovers tracker state from write-ahead logs after failure.

methods.name: writeToLog
methods.description: Writes an event to the write-ahead log if enabled.

methods.name: getReceivedBlockQueue
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the queue of received blocks for a stream.

methods.name: createWriteAheadLog
methods.description: Creates the write-ahead log instance if checkpoint directory is provided.

methods.name: isWriteAheadLogEnabled
methods.description: Checks if write-ahead logging is enabled.
